146 Station Street, Penrith, NSW 2750

Full Time Cook
Salary: $79,423 + Superannuation 

SUMMARY
Located on Station St, in the heart of Penrith City, we at Percy Plunkett, we know what our customers want, and we thrive with passion and expertise to make it possible. That is what defines us. https://percyplunkett.com/
At Percy Plunkett, we are dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. We offer competitive remuneration, opportunities for career growth, and a range of employee benefits to support your work-life balance.
We are seeking an experienced Cook to join our team at Percy Plunkett, Penrith NSW, 2750. This is a full-time position where you will be responsible for preparing high-quality meals for our customers.

Role and Responsibilities
We'd love to have you join our team as a Cook. You will work closely alongside our dedicated Chefs and Cooks, whilst maintaining the highest level of safety and customer service.
•	Selection of correct food ingredients and storing food in temperature-controlled facilities.
•	Preparing main dish Oriental / Western
•	Inspecting food items to ensure they meet quality standards
•	Monitoring and adjusting the temperature of ovens, grills, and other cooking appliances
•	Preparing Salads and Soups
•	Preparing Sauces
•	Preparation of Chicken / meat dishes

•	Preparation of dishes upon request and for special dietary
•	Professional dish presentation.
•	Assisting with menu preparation for Percy Plunkett
•	Maintaining the kitchen area clean and tidy
•	Developing menus, calculating food and labour expenses, and arranging the purchase of food supplies
•	Maintaining cooking tools clean and ready for use.

•	A Certificate IV in Commercial Cooking or relevant certification (Not less than certificate IV)

POSITION: RETAIL STORE MANAGER 
EMPLOYMENT TYPE – FULL-TIME Position – Minimum 38 Hours a Week 
Store Location: 60 MAYNE ST MURRURUNDI 2338 NSW
Salary: $70,000 to $80,000 + Superannuation per Annum
Our client Rab Rakha Pty Ltd (Foodworks Murrurundi) in regional NSW is looking for a permanent retail store manager for a long-term position. The store manager position is essential for the business and someone who can manage the day-to-day operations of the store. 
Responsibility:
Responsible for managing the full customer experience by analysing customer needs, promoting product knowledge, and resolving complaints promptly, while building strong relationships with the local community. Maintains accurate sales and financial records, monitors budgets, conversion, profitability and loss, plans in-store promotional events, and ensures compliance with health, hygiene and workplace safety regulations.

Key Duties: 
•	Manage store operations across all the divisions and ensure retail operations are executed efficiently. 
•	Oversee all daily operations including purchasing, stock management and store flow to maintain business efficiency and a high standard.
•	Use data to analyse the needs of customers, ensure customers are provided with excellent service, demonstrate an unwavering focus on customer satisfaction.
•	Resolve customer complaints and issues in a timely and satisfactory manner. 
•	Build strong relationships with the local community to bring value into the business.
•	Promote and explain the products to customers in relation to their usage, dietary and nutritional values.
•	Recruit, interview, train and supervise new staff ensuring every team member is set up for store success objectives, improve service conversion and sales. 
•	Plan and manage rosters around peak trading periods, events, and seasonal demand while staying within staffing budgets.


•	Keep accurate records of sales, POS transactions, financial data and reconcile sales as per company policies. 
•	Ensure budgets and financial objectives are communicated with staff and are met. 
•	Monitor conversion, sales, profitability, loss and advise the business owner accordingly. 
•	Set pricing strategy, liaising with suppliers, monitor stock levels and ensure products lifecycle and returns of damaged goods. 
•	Plan and oversee in-store promotional events or displays. 
•	Ensure all applicable health and hygiene and workplace safety regulations are adhered to.
Minimum Requirements: 
•	Minimum comparable Diploma AQF Level 
•	Minimum 1 year of highly relevant experience in retail store settings as a manager. 

Application opens from 14 July 2026 to 13 August 2026. Kindly apply with detailed cover letter.  Shortlisted candidates who meets the minimum requirements will be contacted for the interview.

Employer: Z&M FOODS PTY LTD (MARY'S BAO AND DUMPLINGS)
Location: Shop 13 E-CUTZ 13 Hervey Range Rd, Thuringowa Central, QLD, 4810

About us:
Z&M FOODS PTY LTD (Mary’s Bao and Dumplings) specialises in crafting and serving traditional Chinese bao and dumplings, along with a variety of complementary dishes. We are committed to using fresh, high-quality ingredients, with each item carefully handmade to deliver authentic flavours and a satisfying dining experience.

Position Available:
Z&M FOODS PTY LTD (Mary’s Bao and Dumplings) is seeking dedicated FULL-TIME Kitchenhands to join our team.
Reporting to the Head Chef, you will assist with food preparation, maintain kitchen cleanliness, organise ingredients, and support the cooking team during busy service periods. You will also ensure all kitchen equipment and workstations are kept hygienic and safe, in line with food safety standards.
Candidates with prior experience in a fast-paced commercial kitchen environment will be highly regarded. This is a great opportunity to develop your skills while joining a team committed to delivering high-quality, authentic Chinese cuisine.

Responsibilities:
1. Prepare fresh ingredients daily - chop vegetables, peel, portion meats, and prep fillings for our dumplings and bao

3. Set up workstations before service and pack down thoroughly after each shift
4. Pack takeaway and delivery orders carefully, ensuring correct labelling and spill-proof sealing
5. Monitor stock levels and restock ingredients, wrappers, sauces, and chilled drinks during busy periods
6. Wash dishes, pots, and pans; keep all kitchen surfaces clean and organised
7. Follow all food safety and hygiene standards, including proper storage of perishable items

Requirements:
1. AQF Certificate I, or compulsory secondary education
2. Have at least one year of full-time (38 hours per week) relevant work experience undertaken in the last five (5) years
3. Meticulous about cleanliness, portion control, and following standard procedures.
4. Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.

1. Competitive Salary: $72,000 per year package

Painter Blaster – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $80,000 – $110,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Painter Blasters to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Painter Blaster, you will be responsible for preparing, blasting, coating, and painting steel structures, mining equipment, industrial machinery, and fabricated components. You will ensure all surface preparation and protective coating work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project specifications, Australian Standards, and client requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret work instructions, technical drawings, and coating specifications.
•	Prepare steel surfaces by abrasive blasting, power tool cleaning, and other approved surface preparation methods.
•	Apply protective coatings, primers, sealers, and industrial paint systems using airless spray, conventional spray, brush, and roller techniques.
•	Mix paints and coatings in accordance with manufacturer specifications and project requirements.
•	Inspect prepared surfaces and completed coatings to ensure compliance with quality standards and required film thickness.
•	Perform touch-up work, maintenance painting, and coating repairs on mining and industrial equipment.
•	Safely operate blasting equipment, spray-painting equipment, compressors, and other associated tools.
•	Conduct routine maintenance and cleaning of painting and blasting equipment.
•	Maintain accurate records of completed work, coating materials used, and quality inspections.
•	Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, and other trades to meet project deadlines.
•	Assist with shutdown, maintenance, fabrication, and construction projects as required.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety policies, procedures, and environmental requirements.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Painter Blaster or in a similar industrial coatings role.
•	Experience in abrasive blasting, surface preparation, and industrial protective coatings.
•	Knowledge of industrial paint systems, coating application techniques, and quality inspection procedures.
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and coating specifications.
•	Experience working in mining, oil and gas, construction, or heavy industrial environments is highly regarded.
•	Strong commitment to workplace safety, quality workmanship, and environmental compliance.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $80,000 – $110,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.
